name: Sulbutiamine
summary: A thiamine derivative nootropic and stimulant drug. Caution should be used as sulbutiamine reduces dopamine output over time with consistant usage.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: Sulbutiamine is used to treat asthenia (weakness), though is not clear if it is effective in alleviating drowsiness. It is also used to treat thiamine deficiency and poor concentration. Being a potent cholinergic, sulbutiamine is a popular nootropic, with users reporting enhanced memory, focus, and improved mood and motivation. Endurance athletes may use it to try to enhance their performance.

pharmacology.en: It crosses into the brain more easily than thiamine and is broken down into thiamine there, raising levels of thiamine and its active forms. It also appears to affect dopamine and glutamate signalling, but how it produces its effects is not fully understood.
pharmacology.zh: 它比硫胺素更容易進入大腦，並在腦中分解成硫胺素，提高硫胺素及其活性形式的濃度。它似乎也會影響多巴胺與麩胺酸的訊號傳遞，但其作用機制尚未完全清楚。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它比硫胺素更容易进入大脑，并在脑中分解成硫胺素，提高硫胺素及其活性形式的浓度。它似乎也会影响多巴胺与麸胺酸的信号传递，但其作用机制尚未完全清楚。

sideEffects.en: Reported side effects include headache, skin rash, agitation and trouble sleeping. It has been little studied at the amounts people take as a nootropic.
sideEffects.zh: 已知的副作用包括頭痛、皮疹、躁動與失眠。對於人們作為益智藥使用時的用量，相關研究很少。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知的副作用包括头痛、皮疹、躁动与失眠。对于人们作为益智药使用时的用量，相关研究很少。

fact.en: Sulbutiamine was developed in Japan as a fat-soluble form of thiamine (vitamin B1). It is made by joining two modified thiamine molecules through a sulphur bridge, which helps more of it reach the brain.
fact.zh: 舒布硫胺是在日本開發的脂溶性維生素B1（硫胺素）。它由兩個經過修飾的硫胺素分子以硫橋連接而成，讓更多成分能進入大腦。
fact.zhHans: 舒布硫胺是在日本开发的脂溶性维生素B1（硫胺素）。它由两个经过修饰的硫胺素分子以硫桥连接而成，让更多成分能进入大脑。
